fact: The AICCRA-Mali project supported institutionalization of the satellite-based RIICE rice monitoring tool within national agricultural monitoring systems, with the Ministry of Agriculture, the Institut d'Economie Rurale and Mali-Meteo, expanding rice monitoring to the major irrigated and rainfed zones.
title: Institutionalization of the RIICE Tool for Agricultural Investment Planning and Climate Risk Management in Mali
publisher: AICCRA (AfricaRice, IRRI, sarmap with IER and Mali-Meteo)
